main_000.desc: An envoy has come from Mars.

right.desc: Divert resources to make more food.

left.desc: Ration the food and focus our efforts elsewhere.

right.desc: Cut down on power usage to other systems.

left.desc: We can't risk lowering our defences.

main_003.desc: A dusty NASA rover rolls up to our airlock, flashes its headlights, and beeps happily! Its old Houston uplink is dead, and it wants to join the colony.

right.desc: Plug it into our grid and assign it to ice-mining duty!

left.desc: Keep it on the sunlit ridge as a mobile scout and solar bank.

rover_001_ice.desc: Our little buddy is stuck in fluffy 'fairy-castle' dust inside a dark crater! It's spinning its wheels and looking at our cameras for help.

right.desc: Use NASA's 'Inchworm' protocol: lift and wiggle one wheel at a time.

left.desc: Floor the throttle and winch it back up to the sunny rim!

rover_001_scout.desc: The rover knocked off its rear fender while showing off! Now static-charged moon dust is rooster-tailing everywhere and overheating its radiator.

right.desc: Pull an Apollo 17: duct-tape laminated colony maps to make a new fender!

left.desc: Send it into the freezing crater shadow to cool down naturally.

rover_002_ice.desc: Brrr! At 38 Kelvin (-235°C), the rover's drill is chattering. It transmits a puppy-dog warning icon: its batteries will freeze solid in an hour!

right.desc: Follow NASA flight rules: pause drilling and divert power to internal heaters.

left.desc: Abandon the trench and sprint for the sunlit ridge before it freezes!

rover_002_scout.desc: Siren alert! NASA's DONKI satellite spots a massive Solar Flare heading our way. Our rover is exposed on the ridge and could get its brain fried!

right.desc: Command 'Safe Mode': park behind a boulder and angle shields toward the Sun.

left.desc: Tumble down the crater chute into the dark ice basin for natural cover!

rover_003_ice.desc: The rover rolls back to the airlock doing celebratory donuts! Its storage bay is overflowing with pure ancient water-ice from 1 meter underground.

right.desc: Melt it for hydroponic farms and throw our robot pal a parade!

left.desc: Split the water into rocket fuel and oxygen to supercharge the base.

rover_003_scout.desc: Our rover discovered a 'Peak of Eternal Light' bathed in 94% year-round sunshine! It's beaming surplus solar power and Earth memes straight to our colony.

right.desc: Promote it to Chief Energy Officer and link its solar array to our grid!

left.desc: Have it haul back rare lunar rocks to reinforce our colony domes.
